name: Capricorn Systems Global Solutions Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1985, Capricorn Systems 
 Global Solutions Ltd is in the business of computer programming, consultancy and 
 related activities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
CSGSL is an ISO 9001 certified IT organization specializing in software solutions for internet technologies, client/server technology, and platform migration and reengineering. It is associated with Capricorn Systems Inc., Atlanta, USA, and operates a development facility at the Software Technology Park in Hyderabad for executing software projects.
